edges.reason: withdraw restricts the caller to the safe address by comparing msg.sender
withdraw executes msg.sender.transfer of the entire balance, an external value transfer
the low-level value transfer sends ETH back to the untrusted caller address
getVoidPrice gates on block.timestamp >= SALE_START_TIMESTAMP, a timestamp dependency
getVoidPrice reads tokenCounter to enforce FIRST_BATCH_SUPPLY
getVoidPrice returns lastPrice to the caller
createCollectible gates the mint on block.timestamp >= SALE_START_TIMESTAMP
createCollectible derives the token owner from msg.sender
createCollectible increments tokenCounter, a state-changing arithmetic update
createCollectible calls getVoidPrice to compare with msg.value
createCollectible raises lastPrice via lastPrice = lastPrice * 1010 / 1000
createCollectible calls indexToVoid to derive the Void attributes
createCollectible writes tokenIdToRand[lastTokenId] = r
createCollectible writes tokenIdToVoid[lastTokenId] = indexToVoid(r)
createCollectible writes tokenIdToOwner[lastTokenId] = voidOwner
createCollectible calls _safeMint, an ERC721 mint that can invoke the receiver hook
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the recipient contract
the receiver callback executes before tokenCounter and lastPrice are updated, allowing re-entrant minting
burn validates the caller with _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId)

burn resets tokenIdToRand[tokenId] to 0
burn resets tokenIdToVoid[tokenId] to indexToVoid(0)
burn clears tokenIdToOwner[tokenId] to address(0)

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId is only consumed inside setTokenURI and should be folded into the function node
_tokenURI is only used by setTokenURI to set the token metadata
tokenId is only consumed by the burn function logic
idx is fully processed inside indexToVoid's decomposition arithmetic
void is fully processed inside voidToIndex's recomposition arithmetic
lastTokenId is a transient copy of tokenCounter local to createCollectible
